description: DiligenceOps: submit content or product material, with the disclosure you want checked or on its own. The signed report states whether AI involvement is disclosed, where the disclosure sits relative to the content (opening, body or closing, or outside the material), whether its wording names what was generated or assisted (article, images, video, voice, code) and whether it says generated, assisted or both, with any human review clause, hedged wording and assistant wording left in the material quoted. POST /api/ai-disclosure-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-disclosure-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

disclosure.description: Optional disclosure to check, as shown with the material, for example "This article was drafted with AI and edited by our staff." When omitted, the material is searched for its own disclosure.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

material.description: The content or product material as published: an article, post, listing, product page or description, up to 256 KB.

material_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

name: wever_ai-disclosure-check
title: AI disclosure check
